content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(EDR-010 Anomalous Interactive Shell Lineage from Automation Account) AND ABIOC(EDR-010 Living-off-the-Land Discovery Burst Deviating from Account Baseline) — fuses the two auto-tuned behavioral deviations on the same host+account into a single hands-on-keyboard-intrusion incident anchored to the service-account causality chain.
rules.name: Hands-on-Keyboard Intrusion on Automation Account — ABIOC Causality Stitch
